title: Utah Surf Transition
description: A multi-part defensive transition progression where defensemen surf from the inside, force puck separation, retrieve under pressure, then transition through outlets into odd-man attacks.
coaching_points: Defend from the inside and dictate the puck carrier's route.
Protect the dots and control the middle of the ice.
Reload and track quickly after possession changes.
Recover pucks with urgency and transition immediately to offense.

title: D Double Up
description: A two-part breakout and activation drill where defensemen retrieve under pressure, use support options to exit, then join the attack and finish with an offensive-zone sequence.
coaching_points: Shoulder check and scan before every retrieval.
The supporting defenseman stays tight and protects the middle.
Forwards time routes to create clear breakout options.
Defensemen activate with purpose after the puck advances.

title: Toronto 4 Shot Warm-Up
description: A four-shot warm-up progression that combines downhill attacks, weak-side passes, stretch timing, blue-line movement, and layered net-front screens.
coaching_points: Receive passes in stride and attack the dot lane with speed.
Release shots quickly and accurately from different angles.
Time stretch routes through the neutral zone.
Finish with strong net-front presence and layered screens.

title: Pass and Move Circle
description: Players form a large circle and continuously skate on first touch, exchange quick one-touch passes, communicate, and read the movement of teammates as extra pucks are added.
coaching_points: Skate immediately on the first touch.
Execute clean one-touch passes.
Keep the head up and communicate.
Read and react to teammates instead of pre-planning the next pass.

title: 2vs2 Crossroad Passing
description: A confined 2-on-2 possession game with stationary support players on opposite sides. The offense works the puck from one support player to the other using spacing, movement, deception, and quick exchanges.
coaching_points: Move constantly to create soft ice and passing options.
Use body position and deception to protect possession.
Defenders stay tight with active sticks in passing lanes.
Transition immediately after a turnover.
